The shared code also caused DeepSeek/GPT V2 to import KVM work from row 2205 even though this source row contains only sensor checks. Criteria jump from 2 to 102.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by enforcing ED-02 Source Key/Variant isolation: row 2039 is only a passive GB status-sensor check, while row 2205 retains the independent KVM case. GB remains an opaque Project namespace under ED-03 with signed record/component/state mapping. AMBIENT is preserved as a source defect and excluded absent explicit alias proof; ED-15 prohibits invented healthy states and ED-17 preserves fault/SEL evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2039, same-row DeepSeek including its contaminated ai_logs_output, GPT V2, historical record, duplicate-code manifest identities and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2040 / Wistron-BMC-01059-V002 / cec5ba89b17a5227.
The row-2039 Procedure contains no KVM launch, USB-hub condition or console criterion; those belong exclusively to Functionality row 2205 variant eefaa900ff3a4385.
GB is kept opaque and every approved status record is bound to its physical component/zone, record type and raw-to-decoded health model.
AMBIENT is not accepted as GB status evidence unless a signed Project alias explicitly maps it; complete IB/OOB inventories and Web rows remain required.
Criteria 1, 2 and 102 are retained; absent criteria 3-101 are not invented.
No ipmitool, sensor read, KVM launch/use, authentication, Web capture, status/BMC write, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify every Project-defined GB status record is bound to the correct physical GB component or zone and has consistent raw/decoded health, description and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web; exclude all row-2205 KVM coverage.
required_package: Exact row-2039 Source Key/Variant and SUT/BMC/firmware identity; explicit row-2205 KVM exclusion
Signed opaque GB definition, exact status record IDs/types/inclusion list and physical component/zone map
Per-record raw-to-decoded healthy/degraded/failed/unknown rules, thresholds if applicable, aliases and freshness/view crosswalk
Explicit alias proof if AMBIENT is claimed as GB status, preserved fault/SEL context and approved ipmitool
Protected IB/OOB/Web access, BMC/platform owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; verify row-2039 variant identity and preserve GB/BMC/host/SEL evidence. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before filtering, select every approved GB status record by ID/type/physical map, and capture every mapped Web Sensor row. Compare raw/decoded state, description and freshness using the signed decoder. Record AMBIENT as a source defect unless an approved alias proves it. Do not launch KVM, use the synthetic item-title sensor, clear logs, write status/configuration or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved GB status member appears exactly once at the correct component/zone with fresh, aligned and SPEC-defined healthy raw/decoded state in all supported sensor views; no KVM evidence is present and no unrelated AMBIENT record substitutes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact variant isolation, signed GB status population/map/decoder and complete supported-view evidence. FAIL on KVM cross-substitution, unrelated AMBIENT use, wrong component, missing/extra/duplicate/stale record, view mismatch or degraded/failed/unknown state. Missing definition/map/decoder is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive sensor reads only; no KVM action, status/threshold/BMC write, component reset or fault injection.
Preserve fault/SEL evidence and protect credentials; capture full inventories before selection.
Stop on unknown/degraded/failed state, wrong variant/identity, missing/stale record or view disagreement.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve first raw state and context.
expected_evidence: Exact row-2039 Source Key/Variant/hash and row-2205 isolation record
SUT/BMC/firmware plus signed opaque GB population, physical map and raw-state decoder
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web Sensor evidence for every approved status member
Per-member raw/decoded/description/freshness and missing/extra/duplicate analysis with AMBIENT alias decision
No-KVM, numbering, no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong variant/target, access failure, unknown/degraded state or view mismatch, stop passive collection and preserve raw state plus SEL context. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not launch KVM, reset/write, clear logs or retry; escalate exact GB record/component.
